notes.title: Curve Games Publisher sale 2024
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/curvepublishersale_2024
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/30ee8ddf9c6508d9d0668ff16c01acde47fb3e4c.png[/img][/url]

Our 2024 publisher event is here!
 
Grab your virtual hard hat and step into the bustling assembly line: this is where the magic happens, where code and pixels turn ideas into games that captivate millions of players around the world.
 
Take advantage of the best deals we ever offered, check out our new bundles and discover what games we are carefully putting together for the rest of year!

[h1]FOR THE KING II
[/h1]
We’re excited to bring forth this update as our Q1 Quality of Life update. The main focus of this update was to level up the current set of characters skill sets and kits and make certain characters a bit more fun to play. We also have a whole host of global changes - Find skills can now activate on vehicles, we’ve made some changes to how Taunt works, and the dreaded misclick on the overworld costing you focus can now be refunded! 

We’ve also made broad changes to the in-game encyclopedia, reworked tooltips to provide more pertinent information, added a few new settings, squashed a bunch of bugs and smoothed out a few areas of the game. We are once again asking the Kraken to drop more loot. 

[h1]SPACE CREW
[/h1]
Ready for an out-of-this-world adventure? From March 1st to 13th, dive into Space Crew: Legendary Edition for [b]FREE[/b] and keep it forever!

As we gear up for our upcoming release, Badlands Crew, we invite you to join us on a journey across the cosmos.

Take your chance to explore the stars! The offer ends[b] March 13th![/b]
See you among the galaxies! 🚀


[h1]WOBBLY LIFE
[/h1]
We are delighted to announce that Wobbly Life is now available on [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-gb/geforce-now/how-to-play/]GeForce Now[/url]!

[b]What GeForce Now is:[
[/b]
GeForce Now allows you to play your games seamlessly on all your devices; transforming your laptop, desktop, Mac, TV, phone into the most powerful method of gaming!

[b]What else is going on?
[/b]
We’re continuing to work hard on our next update which is [b]coming soon[/b]! 
The next update will contain translation of the game in new languages, new costumes from the latest community contest and many more surprises on... and underneath… Wobbly Island.
We can’t wait to share more about our next update and we hope you will love it as much as we do! 🐸

notes.title: Summer Sale 2023
notes.content:
Summer has arrived, bringing with it the warmth of sunshine and the excitement of this sizzling Summer Sale! As the days get longer and the temperature rises, there's no better time to dive into some thrilling gaming adventures and enjoy fantastic deals. 

Embrace the spirit of the season with our incredible discounts on all titles in our vast catalog. We have something for everyone, whether you're craving action, adventure, or strategy. Enjoy captivating and exciting games like Human Fall Flat, The Ascent, Blooming Business: Casino, From Space, and the adventurous Patch Quest.

Join the crew and become a protector of The Citadel!  

Customize your battle wagon with a wide range of components and weapons, transforming it into a formidable force. Navigate hazardous environments and face off against savage militia groups led by crazed Warlords. Make strategic decisions that shape the campaign map and influence faction control.

Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of this idyllic Austrian Alps destination as you navigate the charming village and uncover the hidden magic within its dungeons. Prepare yourself for a vacation like no other, where adventure and magic intertwine in the alpine paradise.  

Wishlist and join Luisa on the path to becoming a Master Slayer! Welcome to Hinterberg, where the magic of the dungeons awaits your arrival!

notes.title: Rake in some awesome games during the Steam Autumn Sale
notes.content:
Ah, Autumn…

Not too warm nor too cold, with its charming colours, relaxing sights, and nature-defying coffee flavours.

Picture this: you are at your PC, enjoying a nice cup of tea and looking through the window. 
Suddenly, you see a red leaf fall from a nearby tree: reminded about the fleeting nature of life, you decide to have some fun and play a new video game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/Autumnsale2021][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/979620b7202d037e939b9c98872ad7549ad6e2aa.png[/img][/url]

A bit of a stretch? Maybe, but, to celebrate the season, Curve Games is now offering discounts on ALMOST (looking at you, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685910/Lawn_Mowing_Simulator__Ancient_Britain/]Ancient Britain DLC[/url]) its entire catalog.
What are you waiting for? Check them out on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/Autumnsale2021]Autumn Sale page[/url], and rake in a bunch of games at unbeleafable prices!

[i]No, I’m not sorry about these puns.[/i]


[h1]Steam Awards[/h1]

The Steam Awards are back, and throughout the Autumn Sale you'll be able to vote for your favourite games in the 10 categories selected by Valve.

We know it's going to be a hard decision to make, but we would like to humbly suggest some of our games for a few of the available categories.

[list]
[*] The Ascent – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/979690/view/3149700446296381928]"Outstanding Visual Style" Award[/url]
[*] Lawn Mowing Simulator – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1480560/view/3105790349933969482]"Sit back and Relax" Award[/url]
[*] I Am Fish – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1472560/view/3096781247201934409]"Best Game You Suck At" Award[/url]
[*] For The King –[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/527230/view/3131686047795370611]"Labor of Love" Award[/url]
[*] Human: Fall Flat – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/477160/view/3130560147884275312]"Labor of Love" Award[/url]
[*] Autonauts – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/979120/view/3104665083324224893]"Labor of Love" Award[/url]
[*] Embr – [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1062830/view/3150826346207555249]"Better With Friends" Award[/url]
[*] Just Die Already – [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/979070/announcements/detail/3113671649292421055]"Better With Friends" Award[/url]
[/list]
Please consider voting for us if you believe that our games embrace the essence of those categories!


[h2]Lawn Mowing Simulator: New DLC and major update[/h2]

Lawn Mowing Simulator just received its [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1480560/view/4492898490996138736]biggest update yet[/url] with the addition of string trimmers, giving mowing aficionados everywhere an entirely new way to approach the ever growing menace of tall grass in their lawns.
At the same time, the first paid DLC for the game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685910/Lawn_Mowing_Simulator__Ancient_Britain/]Ancient Britain[/url], has been released, containing 4 brand-new challenging locations set in iconic British sites.


[h2]Human: Fall Flat - Lumber[/h2]

Talking about "Labors of Love", earlier this month [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/477160/view/3090026481854611419]we released a 19th level[/url] for our Human: Fall Flat community.
Born from the ingenious mind of David Nielsen, one of our community creators, Lumber will challenge you with a mix of old and new elements.
So limber up, gather some friends, grab an axe and start exploring this amazing new level!


[h2]Space Crew: Thanksgiving Edition[/h2]
Did someone say Thanksgiving?
Enjoy a delectable festive banquet on the Athena station, courtesy of Wing Commander Lyra...just make sure to keep it away from the turkey that will be roaming the deck!
And remember: in space no-one can hear you cluck...

notes.content:
Hi,

We've been very glad to hear from the many players who are enjoying helping Sachi peer through the smoke.

To celebrate the game launching on the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, we've added new content to the game that players on all platforms can experience right now!

Explore the 'Lost Industry' area of the world and you will find BACON, a Help-o-Matic who has been wandering the land looking for new orders for many years.  By completing his quests, you can obtain the Possession Wand, a powerful new weapon which Sachi can use to inhabit the bodies of the monsters she encounters. By becoming a powerful creature she can use its attacks to defeat her enemies. It's great fun and provides yet another way to approach combat in the game.

Now is a great time to revisit the game and discover the fate of Sachi's world for yourself!

Enjoy!

- The Smoke and Sacrifice Team

notes.title: Smoke and Sacrifice Original Soundtrack DLC released
notes.content:
Hi,

The soundtrack to Smoke and Sacrifice plays a important part in creating the mood of other-worldliness and hope that drives Sachi’s story forward. Now, we’re delighted to announce the release of the stand-alone soundtrack on Steam so you can listen to Richard Wilkinson’s beautiful and foreboding compositions whenever you want.

Provided both as as MP3 files and lossless FLAC files, the soundtrack includes new edits of the dynamic music in each part of the world, themes for many of the story moments in the game, and an original track created for the game’s trailer.

Enjoy!

- The Smoke and Sacrifice Team

notes.title: Huge 'Quality of Life' patch coming on 9th July!
notes.content:
Hi!

It’s update time!

We’re so happy to see how positively people have received Smoke and Sacrifice, but we’ve not been resting on our laurels! Solar Sail Games are delighted to announce a new ‘Quality of Life’ update for Smoke and Sacrifice which brings a raft of improvements across the game. Since launch we’ve been been attending closely to our community and this patch addresses many of the most requested fixes and features.

The patch will be arriving on [b]Monday 9th July[/b] so you haven’t long to wait!

[b]Inventory Management Improvements: [/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve added an inventory sort button for instant organisation.
[*] You can now see what you’ve stored inside chests on the map screen. 
[*] We’ve increased stack limits, so you can carry more items.
[*] You can also now merge two stacks by dragging and dropping one onto another.
[/list]
[b]Improved Controls: [/b]
[*] Keys, tokens, quest items and activators can now be used or applied with a single, context-sensitive button press - no need to open the inventory.
[*] We also added a button to equip and unequip your lantern. 
[*] You can now hold your mouse button down to walk continuously.
[/list]
[b]Save System Improvements: [/b]
[*] Story cutscenes now offer the opportunity to save your progress.
[*] Reminders to use the manual save Terminals have been added at key points.
[/list]
[b]Improvements to clarity of objectives: [/b]
[list]
[*] The quest log text and presentation more clearly indicates what to do next. 
[*] The quest log now indicates when a goal isn’t yet possible to complete.
[/list]
[b]Balancing improvements: [/b]
[*] We’ve made weapons gain more health on repair, and last longer than before. 
[*] Boots now last forever, so no more death from shoe expiry in dangerous areas.
[*] The cost of crafting some items is now cheaper, improving game pace.
Improved instructions: 
[*] A warning icon is now shown when equipped items are about to expire. 
[*] Early tutorials have been extended to explain controls and features more fully
[/list]
[b]Options and Tech:[/b]
[*] We’ve added volume sliders to the options screen
[*] We now lock the cursor to the screen on multi-monitor systems in full screen mode.
[*] We’ve also fixed a number of bugs.
[/list]

Burning questions not answered here? Post on the Steam discussion forum for Smoke and Sacrifice or email hello@solarsailgames.com. We’re super-friendly!

- The Smoke and Sacrifice Team

notes.title: Smoke and Sacrifice First Update Available
notes.content:
Hi,

The first Smoke and Sacrifice update is now available. Steam will automatically download this version for you, so you don't need to do anything to receive it.

Here are the changes we’ve made in this version: 
[list]
[*] The game now recognises the Xbox 360 Wireless Adaptor and unofficial Xbox 360/Xbox One controllers. 
[*] We’ve increased how long boots last, and their durability goes up even more when you upgrade them. 
[*] We improved how mouse clicks are handled to make it easy to pick up items that have fallen behind trees. 
[*] We’ve fixed some bugs with drag and drop and with Steam Controller implementation. 
[*] A Japanese translation has been added to the game. 
[/list]

We hope everyone’s enjoying the game. Keep watching this feed for further updates. 

- Solar Sail Games

notes.title: Hints and Tips for Smoke and Sacrifice
notes.content:
[h1]Controls[/h1]

If you’re playing with a mouse and keyboard, the best way to control Sachi is to use the WASD keys. Click the right mouse button to attack, and the left mouse button to investigate objects in the world.

The game has a quick weapon switch which you’ll also find useful. Use the mouse wheel or the shoulder buttons on a controller to switch between weapons.

[h1]Save Your Game Often[/h1]

Smoke and Sacrifice doesn’t save the game for you. For that, you need to find a Save Terminal. Remember to use them frequently. The underworld is a dangerous place, and if your last save is a long way back, being killed will really hurt!

[h1]Prepare for Smoketime[/h1]

Once you reach the underworld, you have only a short amount of time before the Smoke arrives. Light sources such as glowferns and save terminals will protect you, but leave you stuck in one spot and vulnerable to attack. What you really need is a lantern, so don’t delay - find someone friendly who will tell you how to make one!

[h1]Show that Bear![/h1]

Some of the characters you’ll meet in the game will ask to see special items you’re carrying, indicated by a floating icon above their head. When this happens, you’ll need to stand near the character, open your inventory, choose the item in question, then select ‘Show’.

[h1]Fighting Is Not Always the Answer[/h1]

Finding the combat tough? You’ll find that crafting or upgrading your armour and weapons can make fights a lot easier. You can often find creative ways of dispatching creatures without combat, or getting a helping hand from other creatures in a battle...

[h1]Don’t Know What to Do Next?[/h1]

Stuck? Don’t worry! Revealing the mysteries of the Smoke can be tricky at times. The Quest Log always shows you what you can do next though. Press ‘Q’ on the keyboard or D-pad up on a controller to see it. 

Still stuck? Post on the Steam discussion forum for the game or drop us an email on hello@solarsailgames.com and we’ll help you out!
